comment: ANCHOR: NEWS_TO_CATALYST_GATE_EXCLUSIONS_20261107 — a candidate refused by an identity gate
(research-directive slug, not in the ticker universe) was never eligible, so it is reported under
excluded_reasons and subtracted from attempted_count instead of counted as a skip the run chose. The
receipt writer carries the field (LaneRunReceipt@v2) and run_quality reads it as a stated structural
exclusion. A full run with gate refusals no longer grades DEGRADED for 'skipped N, more than it
